snippet.title: The Steam page for Raiders World: Armita’s Search is LIVE!
snippet.description:
Lead Armita through the ruthless Barrens, fight turn-based tactical card battles, and make choices that shape her Humanity — and the ending.
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4302760/?utm_source=y

Raiders World: Armita’s Search is a story-driven, single-player, tactical roguelite card game set in a post-apocalyptic world, where being kind in the Barrens is the hardest path.

What to expect:
— 12+ hours of gameplay
— Dozens of unique enemies, each with their own mechanics
— Dozens of named companions with mini-decks
— Hundreds of cards
— Hundreds of story events
— A distinctive, stylized art style
— A colorful, original post-apocalyptic universe you’ll want to return to
— Coming later: a comic and a PBtA tabletop RPG

Please wishlist the game and share it with friends — we’re a tiny indie team with no marketing budget, and every wishlist helps Steam show the game to real players.

Wishlist it now. Thanks! Together, we’ll cross the Barrens.
